text:
Estimate for the plate: stir-fried noodles with beef and vegetables, plus two small boiled potatoes.

- Noodles with meat and vegetables: about 250 g at roughly 1.5 kcal/g, so about 375 kcal.
- Two small potatoes: about 90 g at roughly 0.8 kcal/g, so about 70 kcal.
- Total: about 340 g and about 445 kcal. Oil in the stir-fry could push it higher, so I rounded up to 460 kcal.

The drink and the wrapped chocolate are not on the plate, so I left them out.
